# UnnecessaryFinalModifier

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `UnnecessaryFinalModifierInspection`

`final` on a method is redundant when the class itself is `final` (nothing can
extend it) or when the method is `private` (it cannot be overridden anyway,
constructors and other magic methods aside).

## Example

::: code-group

```php{5,6,12,13} [Before]
<?php
class Engine
{
    final protected function start() {}
    final private function ignite() {}
    private static final function spark() {}
    final private function __clone() {}
}

final class Turbine
{
    final public function spin() {}
    final protected function __wakeup() {}
    public function idle() {}
}

class Gauge
{
    public int $level {
        final get => 1;
    }
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
class Engine
{
    final protected function start() {}
    private function ignite() {}
    private static function spark() {}
    final private function __clone() {}
}

final class Turbine
{
    public function spin() {}
    protected function __wakeup() {}
    public function idle() {}
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 5: Redundant final: the method cannot be overridden anyway.</li>
<li>line 6: Redundant final: the method cannot be overridden anyway.</li>
<li>line 12: Redundant final: the method cannot be overridden anyway.</li>
<li>line 13: Redundant final: the method cannot be overridden anyway.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "UnnecessaryFinalModifier": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore UnnecessaryFinalModifier

/**
 * @noinspection UnnecessaryFinalModifierInspection
 */
```
